description: build_jmap_dispatcher allocates a new HashMap and does 31 Arc::clone + HashMap::insert operations on every JMAP request. Dispatcher<JmapCaller> is Send+Sync (per jmap-server design) and its only per-request data (JmapCaller) is passed to dispatch() at call time, not at construction. Could be built once in AppState::new() and stored as Arc<Dispatcher<JmapCaller>> — removing ~31 allocations per request. Worth fixing once AppState initialization is settled.
title: build_jmap_dispatcher rebuilt per JMAP request — Dispatcher could be cached in AppState
